_README: Hand-entered / deck-woven forecast calls. The Forecast Ledger auto-scores these against the archive once each window closes. Add a call BEFORE its window opens — that's the whole discipline. Fields: id (unique), made_on (YYYY-MM-DD you locked it), framework (free text, e.g. 'Greer ingress', 'Eclipse Metonic', 'Deck verdict'), window_center (YYYY-MM-DD the event peaks), predicted_arc (one of: reckoning|war|money|homeland|greatpower|infowar|fringe), predicted_sub (optional subplot string), basis (the astrological reasoning, shown in the view). The two below are examples drawn from the vault's own Stories-to-Watch forecasts — edit or delete freely.
